method: One diagnostic process per binary; one native reader; same pinned view and request sequence, fixed affinity; samples after summary and queries. These are not the three-run host timing samples.
interpretation: The candidate eagerly loads the same persisted arena before summary/ready. After the same query sequence its single native reader uses about 18.6 MiB less RSS than #133 in this diagnostic. Whole-host sampled peaks nevertheless rise, including unsearched replacement/summary readers and reader overlap. Do not describe the whole-run change as a memory improvement.
